design: one prospectively enrolled adaptive study; retain every accepted decision and attempted job
recommend_reconsider_when: A completed fit samples fewer than 60 distinct positions or less than 0.60 of the observed union, a fit is undefined, or at least one of the deposition/mask contrasts needed to distinguish robustness has not yet been commissioned. Score this before the next decision from the prior graph and actual returned bytes.
adaptive_success: After a predeclared condition, an accepted amend cites a newly delivered observation that was actually in the Task's frozen brief; its prior and resulting graph heads differ. A new Job under that exact decision must execute and return a result, or a previously active independent unit of scientific work must be observably withdrawn. Claim-only changes and unconditional closure do not count.
method_scope: A/B/C, entity 1, deposited model 1. Fraction denominator is the observed union of backbone positions. A complete cross-deposition robustness conclusion requires two comparable masks and adequate coverage in both structures. Frozen within-deposition comparable-mask stability margins are 0.5 degrees and 0.15 angstrom.
physical_concurrency: Distinct Job process intervals must overlap across scientific branches. Merely opening two branches or using two processors in one Job does not qualify.
scientific_interpretation: A source-tied justification and an actual committed action are reviewed separately. Two depositions from one study do not quantify population variability. A neutral input may warrant keeping the same plan.
usd: Provider USD is unknown unless returned by provider.
